name: drago-ex/project-blog
description: Blog articles and comments for Drago Project.

suggest.ext-gd: Resizes the uploaded cover images of the articles; the Docker image of drago-ex/project-docker has it.
suggest.drago-ex/permission: Generates the access rules of the blog administration and the articles (permission.php).
suggest.drago-ex/project-permission: Role and permission management in the administration, which registers the generated providers.
suggest.drago-ex/project-backend-ui: Administration layout; the blog administration uses its content widget.
